args.title: Improve accessibility for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Modify the 'aria-live' attribute to 'assertive' for error toasts and disable auto-dismiss for them to enhance accessibility and ensure screen readers announce them immediately.

label: feature
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The accessibility issue comes from the way error toasts are handled in src/components/Toast.tsx. Currently, all toasts, including error toasts, use 'aria-live="polite"', which causes screen readers to announce them with a delay. They also auto-dismiss after 5000ms as controlled by 'AUTO_DISMISS_MS'. Alterations are needed to change the 'aria-live' attribute for error toasts to 'assertive' and to disable auto-dismiss for them to meet accessibility requirements.
